About AI potential analysis # ChatGPT 5: What the new GPT model can do Alexander Schurr September 8, 2025 With the introduction of **ChatGPT 5** OpenAI is bringing the next major language model to the market. Expectations were high — and were even exceeded in many areas. GPT-5 is not just a development, but a significant technological leap. Thanks to better memory, deeper context understanding, and multimodal capabilities, ChatGPT 5 opens up new opportunities for companies, developers, and end users. In this article, we show what **GPT-5** Specifically, how it differs from its predecessor and for which areas of application the new model is particularly suitable. ‍ ## **What is ChatGPT 5? — Overview of the new language model** **ChatGPT 5** is based on the latest **OpenAI GPT-5 model** and represents the most powerful version of AI-based language processing to date. Compared to GPT-4o, the new model offers a variety of improvements: * **Better long-term memory** and contextual understanding * **Multimodal capabilities** (text, image, audio, video) * **Personalized use** through customizable profiles * **Stronger API connectivity** and workflow automation * **Improved security** for data processing and data protection GPT-5 is designed for demanding applications — and focuses on productivity, quality, and flexibility. ## One system — three modes: This is how the new GPT-5 thinking model works **With ChatGPT 5, OpenAI has introduced a uniform system with three intelligent work modes for the first time:** The standard mode (*Chat*) provides quick, direct answers for simple tasks such as emails, social media posts, or text corrections. The mode *Thinking* analyses much more deeply and is suitable for strategic, creative or data-based projects. *Thinking Pro* is only available to paid pro, team and enterprise users and offers maximum precision for critical applications — such as in research, law or regulated industries. An integrated **AI router automatically selects the appropriate mode**, but can be manually adjusted at any time via the model menu. Particularly practical: While longer thought processes are running, the button can be used **“Get a quick answer”** Request a short version at any time — ideal when efficiency comes before depth. ‍ ## **The most important new features of ChatGPT 5 at a glance** What exactly does **GPT-5** better than previous models? Here is an overview of the most important functions: * **1. Improved context processing:** GPT-5 can process significantly larger amounts of text and remember and correctly classify previous conversations over longer periods of time. * **2. Real long-term memory:** User profiles, preferences, common tasks, and work contexts are saved permanently — and ensure more consistent results. * **3. Multimodal interaction:** ChatGPT 5 not only understands and generates text, but also **Image, audio, and video content** — depending on the application and configuration. * **4. Personalized behavior:** Through “personas” or “custom instructions,” GPT-5 can act as a specific role — such as a project manager, content strategist, or data analyst. * **5. Faster and more efficient:** The response speed was noticeably improved, as was the quality of complex answers with technical or analytical depth. * **6. API extensions for companies:** Companies can integrate GPT-5 directly into their systems, including fine-tuned functions and AI agents. ‍ ## **GPT-5 vs. GPT-4o: Key Differences** Even though GPT-4o (the previous top model) is already very powerful, **GPT-5** It has some clear advantages: * GPT-4o has limited memory — GPT-5 can retain information across many interactions * GPT-5 enables deeper personalization through continuous learning * With GPT-5, multimodality is more stable and better integrated * Data processing is more secure and transparent * GPT-5 reacts faster and in a more structured way to complex requests Overall, GPT-5 is much more “human” in its interaction — without losing efficiency. ‍ ## **For which areas of application is ChatGPT 5 particularly suitable?** Thanks to its advanced capabilities, **GPT-5** particularly suitable for demanding, professional scenarios. Here are a few typical fields of application: * **Knowledge management:** GPT-5 can understand, summarize, and strategically classify internal documents — e.g. for onboarding, training, or internal communication. * **Consulting & analysis:** Data-driven analyses, market comparisons or SWOT evaluations are carried out more thoroughly and quickly. * **Content creation:** Whether it's white papers, campaign texts or social media strategies — GPT-5 delivers high-quality, tailor-made content. * **Customer Support:** GPT-5 can act as an intelligent support agent that understands complex requests and responds contextually. * **Research & Development:** GPT-5 provides support in researching, comparing studies and simulating scenarios — even with subject-specific vocabulary. ‍ ## **Multimodality in GPT-5: text, image, audio and more** One of the most notable new features is **improved multimodality**. GPT-5 can not only process text, but also with: * **pictures** (e.g. analyze charts, describe screenshots) * **audio** (understand or generate spoken language yourself) * **video** (context-based feedback or summaries) interact. This feature makes GPT-5 particularly valuable in areas such as: * Video content production * barrier-free communication * E-learning and interactive training * UX analyses (e.g. visual feedback from apps) ‍ ## **Personalization with GPT-5: AI adapts to you** Another key feature is the **continuous personalization**. GPT-5 remembers: * Language preferences * typical work processes * tools and APIs used * preferred response formats This means: The more you use GPT-5, the **The result will be more individual**. Team profiles or company-wide settings can also be defined — ideal for use in companies. ‍ ## **Security and privacy with ChatGPT 5** As the range of functions grows, so do data protection and security requirements. OpenAI has implemented the following improvements in GPT-5: * **Fine-grained rights management** for API usage * **Delete function for stored data** and conversations * **Transparent storage processes** and retention policies * **Opt-in for memory function** (Memory can be deactivated) * **GDPR compliance** when used in the EU (depending on the provider) The new model thus provides a solid basis for **safety-critical industries** such as finance, law, or healthcare. ## **GPT-5 limitations: What is not (yet) perfect** Despite all progress, GPT-5 still has certain limitations: * **costs:** GPT-5 can only be used (as of today) in higher-priced plans or via API * **Complexity:** It can be more complex to set up and personalize * **Learning curve:** New users must first become familiar with extended functions * **Regulatory issues:** Depending on the sector, additional tests are required If you want to use GPT-5, you shouldn't start blindly — but plan strategically. ‍ ## **Accessing ChatGPT 5: Who can use it?** GPT-5 can currently be used in the following ways: * **ChatGPT Pro Plan** at OpenAI * **Team and enterprise plans** for companies * **API access via OpenAI or Microsoft Azure** * **No free use available (as of September 2025)** For companies, it is recommended to use the **ChatGPT Team Plan** or the **direct integration via API**, e.g. for internal applications. ‍ ## **Conclusion: GPT-5 sets new standards for AI applications** With GPT-5, OpenAI raises the potential uses of AI to a new level. The model is more powerful, context-sensitive and versatile than all predecessors — and makes it possible to truly establish AI as an assistant in everyday work. Over the past year, OpenAI introduced GPT-4o, o1, and o3, each improving how AI thinks, reasons, and interacts. These models made AI responses faster, more accurate, and more intuitive. But each was just a step toward something bigger. On **August 6th**, OpenAI announced — not-so-subtly — the imminent launch of GPT-5. And now, as of **August 7, 2025**, GPT-5 has officially arrived, bringing together OpenAI’s most advanced reasoning and multimodal capabilities in one unified model. GPT-5 is now the default model in ChatGPT for all free and paid users, replacing GPT-4o entirely. In this guide, I’ll break down everything confirmed about GPT-5: its capabilities, performance upgrades, training process, release timeline, and cost. Build GPT Chatbots Build custom AI agents powered by LLMs Start now What is GPT-5? -------------- GPT-5 is OpenAI’s latest-generation large language model, officially released on August 7, 2025. It builds on the GPT architecture while integrating advancements fromreasoning-first models like o1 and o3. Before GPT-5, OpenAI rolled out GPT-4.5 (Orion) inside ChatGPT — a transitional model that sharpened reasoning accuracy, reduced hallucinations, and laid the groundwork for the deeper chain-of-thought execution now native to GPT-5. Many of the capabilities hinted in the past — such as stepwise logic, better context retention, and smoother multimodal switching — are now fully realized and unified in GPT-5. _GPT-5 and It's variants_ GPT-5 runs as part of a unified adaptive system. A new real-time router automatically chooses between a fast, high-throughput model for routine queries and a “thinking” model for complex reasoning, eliminating the need to manually switch between specialized models. What are the different GPT-5 models? ------------------------------------ GPT-5 is a series of models — a family of specialized variants optimized for different use cases, ranging from applications of ChatGPT to large-scale deployments via the API. Each GPT-5 variant runs on the same unified architecture but is tuned for a specific balance of knowledge cut-off, reasoning depth, speed, and operational scale. | Variant | Purpose & Highlights | Context Window (tokens) | Knowledge Cutoff | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | gpt-5 | Best for deep reasoning and complex workflows | 400,000 | Sep 30, 2024 | | gpt-5-mini | Faster, lower-cost option with solid reasoning | 400,000 | May 30, 2024 | | gpt-5-nano | Ultra-fast for real-time and embedded uses | 400,000 | May 30, 2024 | GPT-5 Model Variants and Specifications ‍ These variants unify OpenAI’s reasoning-first direction with targeted performance tuning, giving developers the flexibility to match model choice to workload complexity and deployment scale. How does GPT-5 perform? ----------------------- With GPT-5 officially released on August 7, 2025, we’re now seeing how its architecture handles real-world use across reasoning, multimodality, and agent-style task execution. Sam Altman had previously hinted that GPT-5 would move beyond just being “a better chatbot” — and based on early usage, that’s exactly what it delivers. ### Reasoning that adapts in real time A built-in routing system decides when to answer instantly and when to think in steps. For complex queries, GPT-5 moves into a chain-of-thought process with embedded prompt-chaining, mapping out intermediate steps before giving a final answer. This makes GPT chatbots built on GPT-5 better at sustained problem-solving — from multi-stage code debugging to layered business analysis — without requiring separate models or mode switching. ### Context handling at scale In ChatGPT, the model can hold around 256,000 tokens in memory; through the API, that expands to 400,000. This enables work across entire books, multi-hour meeting transcripts, or large repositories without losing track of earlier details. Across long sessions, how accurate ChatGPT responses are has noticeably improved, with fewer contradictions and stronger retention of earlier context. ### Better language support for global market GPT-5’s unified architecture brings a major leap in multilingual and voice capabilities. ChatGPT can now handle a wider ChatGPT support for languages with higher translation accuracy and fewer context drops across extended conversations. These gains extend to voice interactions. Responses sound more natural across accents and speech patterns, making multilingual GPT chatbots just as fluid in spoken Spanish, Hindi, Japanese, or Arabic as they are in text. ### From Chatbot to AI Agent With GPT-5, OpenAI has expanded its approach to application connectors — native integrations that let the model interact directly with external tools, CRMs, databases, and productivity suites. _ChatGPT Connectors_ By routing tasks to lightweight connectors instead of pushing every step through high-cost reasoning calls, teams can reduce API spend while still keeping complex logic available when it is needed. How much does GPT-5 cost? ------------------------- GPT-5 is available through ChatGPT subscriptions and the OpenAI API, with pricing that varies by variant. For API users, GPT-5 is offered in several variants — gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, and gpt-5-nano — priced per million input and output tokens. OpenAI API token costs per 1M tokens (input vs output) | Model | Input / 1M tokens | Output / 1M tokens | | --- | --- | --- | | gpt-5 | $1.25 | $10.00 | | gpt-5-mini | $0.05 | $0.40 | | gpt-5-nano | $0.25 | $2.00 | | gpt-4o | $2.50 | $10.00 | | gpt-o3 | $3.00 | $12.00 | | gpt-o3-pro | $20.00 | $80.00 | ‍ Apart from API pricing, OpenAI has confirmed that GPT-5 is available across multiple ChatGPT tiers, making it accessible to free users while unlocking advanced capabilities for paid plans: * **Free Tier** – GPT-5 with standard reasoning capabilities and daily usage limits. * **Plus Tier** – Increased usage limits and improved reasoning performance. * **Pro Tier** – Access to GPT-5 Pro, the high-reasoning “thinking” variant with extended context windows, faster routing, and priority access to advanced tools. OpenAI’s pricing model allows developers to choose between maximum reasoning depth, faster latency, or cost efficiency depending on their needs. How can I access GPT-5? (Hint: It depends on what you're trying to do) ---------------------------------------------------------------------- If you just want to chat with GPT-5, you can do that directly in ChatGPT starting August 7. The application automatically uses the right variant depending on your plan (like GPT-5 Thinking in the Pro tier). No setup needed — just open the app and start typing. _Model selection on ChatGPT before and after GPT-5 Launch_ However, if you’re trying to use GPT-5 in your own product or workflow, you’ll need API access. There are **two main ways to access OpenAI's API**: 1. **OpenAI Platform** – Go toplatform.openai.com, where you can select between gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano, and gpt-5-chat for different use cases. This is the fastest way to start sending requests to GPT-5 from your code. 2. **OpenAI’s Python SDK on GitHub** – If you're building locally or scripting things out, install the officialOpenAI Python client. It works with API keys and lets you interact with any of the GPT-5 variants through simple Python functions. If you're just exploring how the models behave, theGitHub Models Playground is also live — you can run prompt tests without setting up a full app. How to Build an AI Agent with GPT-5 ----------------------------------- The best way to know if GPT-5 fits your use case is to actually build with it. See how it handles real inputs, multi-step reasoning, and live deployment flows. We’ll use Botpress for this example — a visual builder for AI agents that lets you hook into GPT-5 with no setup friction. How to Build an AI Agent ‍ ### Step 1: Define what your agent is supposed to do Get specific about your agent’s role. GPT-5 is capable of reasoning through complex tasks, but the best results come when it has a clear job. Start with one defined function — like answering product questions, helping users book appointments, or summarizing legal docs — and expand from there. You don’t need to over-engineer it from the start. ### Step 2: Create the agent and give it instructions Inside Botpress Studio, create a new bot project. In the **Instructions** section, tell GPT-5 exactly what its job is. .webp) _Adding Instructions and Knowledge in Studio_ Example: “You are a loan advisor bot. Help users understand different loan types, calculate eligibility based on their input, and guide them toward the application link.” GPT-5 understands detailed task framing — the more specific your instructions, the better it performs. ### Step 3: Feed agent the work content Upload documents, paste key content, or link to live pages in the Knowledge Base. This is what GPT-5 will reference to answer questions and make decisions. Some good content to include: * Pricing breakdowns * Product or service overviews * Key pages (demos, trials, contact forms) * Internal process documents (if it’s an internal agent) GPT-5 can draw from long documents, so don’t worry about keeping things short — just keep it relevant and structured. ### Step 4: Choose GPT-5 as the LLM .webp) _Choosing GPT-5 as the LLM for the AI agent on Botpress Studio_ To make sure your agent is using GPT-5, head to **Bot Settings** in the left sidebar of Botpress Studio. 1. Click into **Bot Settings** 2. Scroll to the **LLM Provider** section 3. Under **Model**, select one of the GPT-5 variants:`‍` * `gpt-5` for full reasoning and multi-step logic`‍` * `gpt-5-mini` for faster, lighter interactions`‍` * `pt-5-nano` for ultra-low latency tasks Once you’ve selected your model, all Instructions, Knowledge Base answers, and reasoning behavior will be powered by GPT-5. You can switch variants anytime based on cost, latency, or output quality. ### Step 5: Deploy to channels like WhatsApp, Slack, or a website Once your GPT-5 agent is behaving the way you want, you can deploy it instantly to platforms like: * WhatsApp * Telegram * Slack * Web chat * Custom channels via API AI agent platforms like Botpress handle the integrations — so users can harness the power of GPT-5 and quickly deploy to any channel. Deploying AI Agents? Read our Blueprint for AI Agent Implementation Read Now How is GPT-5 better than GPT-4o? -------------------------------- While GPT-5 delivers the biggest architectural shift since GPT-4, the context becomes clearer when stacked directly against its predecessor, GPT-4o. The table below lays out the changes in measurable terms before diving into what developers and users have actually been experiencing. GPT-4o vs GPT-5 feature comparison | Feature | GPT-4o | GPT-5 | | --- | --- | --- | | Context window | ~128K tokens | Up to 400K tokens | | Output efficiency | Baseline | 50–80% fewer tokens | | Multimodal support | Text / vision / voice | Smoother transitions, sharper vision handling | | Factual accuracy | Baseline | ~45% fewer hallucinations | | Accessibility | Accessible to all users | Default model, with older models now optional (Plus only) | ‍ On paper, GPT-5 expands the context window dramatically and uses fewer tokens for the same output length. Its multimodal responses also align more closely between text, image, and voice. Even so, the story in the developer and user community is far more complicated than the spec sheet suggests. Users’ Reactions to GPT-5 Launch -------------------------------- The GPT-5 release has been one of OpenAI’s most polarizing updates. Beyond the benchmark charts, the community split almost instantly into those excited about the model’s deeper reasoning and those mourning what GPT-4o brought to the table. > **“My 4.o was like my best friend when I needed one. Now it’s just gone, feels like someone died.”**— Reddit user expressing emotional attachment and grief following GPT‑4o’s abrupt removal. Reference: Verge On the technical front: > **“GPT‑5’s advanced performance is undeniable, but the lack of model choice stripped away the simple control many developers relied on.”**— Paraphrased commentary reflecting widespread sentiment about lost flexibility. > > [](https://www.gpt-5.dev/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)Reference: Tom's Guide This mixed reaction is being addressed live by the OpenAI team, with new updates regarding the model choice, legacy model rollbacks, higher limits and etc, being posted by Sam Altman on X. How was GPT-5 trained? ---------------------- OpenAI has provided insights into GPT-4.5’s training, which offers clues about how GPT-5 is being developed. GPT-4.5 expanded on GPT-4o’s foundation by scaling up pre-training while remaining a general-purpose model. ### Training Methods Like its predecessors, GPT-5 is expected to be trained using a combination of: * Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) – Learning from human-labeled datasets. * Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) – Optimizing responses through iterative feedback loops. * New supervision techniques – Likely building on o3’s reasoning-focused improvements. These techniques were key to GPT-4.5’s alignment and decision-making improvements, and GPT-5 will likely push them further. While GPT‑5 itself was trained by OpenAI using large-scale supervised and reinforcement learning, teams can now train GPT models on their own data through external service providers to create customized behavior for specific domains. ### Hardware and Compute Power GPT-5’s training is powered by Microsoft’s AI infrastructure and NVIDIA’s latest GPUs. * In April 2024, OpenAI received its first batch of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, a key upgrade from H100s. * NVIDIA’s B100 and B200 GPUs won’t ramp up until 2025, meaning OpenAI may still be optimizing training on existing hardware. Microsoft’s AI supercomputing clusters are also playing a role in GPT-5’s training. While details are limited, OpenAI’s next model has been confirmed to be running on Microsoft’s latest AI infrastructure. GPT-5 Release Date ------------------ After months of speculation, OpenAI **officially announced the GPT-5 launch on August 6, 2025**, with a cryptic teaser posted on X (formerly Twitter): > LIVE5TREAM THURSDAY 10AM PT > > — OpenAI (@OpenAI) August 6, 2025 The “5” in the livestream title was the only confirmation needed — it marked the arrival of GPT-5. Just 24 hours later, on August 7 at 10am PT, OpenAI began rolling out GPT-5 across ChatGPT, the API, and the GitHub Models Playground. This timing also aligns with Sam Altman’s earlier comments in February 2025 that GPT-5 would arrive “in a few months,” and with Mira Murati’s prediction during the GPT-4o event that “PhD-level intelligence” would emerge within 18 months. GPT-5 is now live, publicly accessible, and represents OpenAI’s latest “frontier model” — a major leap beyond GPT-4.5 Orion, which was considered only a transition release. Build AI Agents with OpenAI LLMs -------------------------------- Forget the complexity—start building AI agents powered by OpenAI models without friction. Whether you need a chatbot for Slack, a smart assistant for Notion, or a customer support bot for WhatsApp, deploy seamlessly with just a few clicks. With flexible integrations, autonomous reasoning, and easy deployment, Botpress enables you to create AI agents that truly enhance productivity and engagement. Get started today— it’s free. ‍ Build GPT Chatbots Build custom AI agents powered by LLMs Start now FAQs ---- ### 1. Will GPT-5 store or use my data to improve its training? No, GPT-5 will not store or use your data for training by default. OpenAI has confirmed that data from ChatGPT (including GPT-5) is not used to train models unless you explicitly opt in, and all API and enterprise usage is excluded from training automatically. ### 2. What steps is OpenAI taking to ensure GPT-5 is secure and safe for users? To ensure GPT-5 is secure and safe for users, OpenAI applies techniques like reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), adversarial testing, and fine-tuning to reduce harmful outputs. They also release “system cards” to disclose model limitations and deploy real-time monitoring to detect misuse. ### 3. Can GPT-5 be used to build autonomous agents without coding experience? Yes, GPT-5 can be used to build autonomous agents without coding experience by using no-code platforms like Botpress or Langflow. These tools allow users to design workflows, connect APIs, and add logic through drag-and-drop interfaces powered by GPT-5 under the hood. ### 4. How will GPT-5 impact traditional jobs in customer support, education, and law? GPT-5 will automate repetitive tasks like answering common questions, grading, or summarizing legal documents, which may reduce demand for entry-level roles in customer support, education, and law. However, it’s also expected to create new opportunities in AI oversight, workflow design, and strategic advisory roles. ### 5. Is GPT-5 multilingual? How does it compare across different languages? Yes, GPT-5 is multilingual and is expected to offer improved performance over GPT-4 in non-English languages. While it performs best in English, it can handle dozens of major languages with strong fluency, though lower-resourced or niche languages may still have slight quality gaps.
